experiment: R2 new source test of pre-solve conditional RAW / standalone exact GF2 selection
hypothesis: A conservative pre-solve selector, fit ONLY to prior R1 source-bound results, avoids GF2 for small full-XOR CNF and uses certified GF2 for sufficiently large exact full-XOR originals, beating the fastest successful competing solver on multiple NEW sources without material regret elsewhere.
training_source_only: R1 19x19/25x25/37x37 repeated runs #41607003603 and #41607533186 with archived source/receipt SHAs in experiments/time_sat_004_external/E12C5_R1_POSTRUN_REPORT.json

selector_frozen_before_tests.decision: IF n<500 THEN CaDiCaL195 original; ELSE ONLY IF EVERY original CNF clause belongs to an exact certified XOR parity block THEN standalone GF2; OTHERWISE CaDiCaL195 original. No solver calls, SAT/UNSAT answers, benchmark timing or planted model may influence selector.
selector_frozen_before_tests.rationale: R1 at n=361 lost vs best RAW/CaDiCaL; at n=625 and n=1369 GF2 exceeded CMS native; 500 is a simple frozen separating threshold, not fitted to R2.

source_generation: Use same row-major 5-neighbor Lights-out toggle XOR construction, Python random.Random(seed).getrandbits(1), complete 2^(k-1) CNF clauses for each cell; SHA256 full canonical n+rows generated before first measurement; immutable sizes/seeds/implementation. All models satisfy EVERY original clause.

negative_controls.require: exact cover rejects; selected chooses untouched original CaDiCaL
same-admin contradiction replay; not as proof of general SAT, not new R2 benchmark
reject any source SHA collision with 3 old R1 and 4 new R2 cases

success_gates.per_case_per_host: selector and fastest *successful verified* baseline must both have 3/3 SAT_VERIFIED, using medians of full cold child wall; source speedup = min(all baseline median times with 3 SAT_VERIFIED) / selector median. No finite speedup imputed to censored baseline.
success_gates.narrow_pre_registered: At least 2/4 NEW sources with >=1.20x ratio on BOTH Ubuntu hosts, all 4 sources with ratio >=1/1.05 on BOTH hosts, selector decisions invariant across both hosts, every SAT output fully replayed on original CNF. If true report CONDITIONAL_NEW_SOURCE_CLASS_GAIN_CANDIDATE, not universal SAT claim.
success_gates.censoring: Time-limited baseline is explicitly RIGHT_CENSORED; do not call it solved or grant imaginary ratio. Qualify any narrow gain if a major baseline cannot finish.
success_gates.all_baselines_full_evidence: Separate stricter scientific gate; every baseline 3/3 verified on ALL new sources. A censored CaDiCaL means all-baselines gate NOT PASSED even if narrow gain candidate.
success_gates.no_stage5_promotion: Even passing narrow gates does not constitute stage 5 universal SAT or independent sealed generalization; external administrator and new sealed cross-family data required.
